svg.title: Azure Service Bus topic splitting flow
svg.desc: Pass 1, intake: the producer publishes messages with no routing marker to test-topic. The temporary ingest subscription mirrord-ingest-* has the rule route IS NULL, so it captures the raw messages. The mirrord forwarder in the operator reads them and applies the filter, a header regex plus jq over the body. It stamps mirrord_route on each message: matched messages get route = the session id, and unmatched messages get route = main. The forwarder re-publishes each message to the same topic. Pass 2, delivery: the session subscription mirrord-s-* has the rule route = the session id and delivers matched messages to the developer running mirrord exec. The app subscription test-sub has the rule route = main and delivers unmatched messages to the deployed app, which is unchanged and not restarted.
